sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fmap over Nothing — applying any transformation to Nothing always yields Nothing
sketches.resonance: No matter what you try to give someone who is absent, the result is still absence.
sketches.draft:
poem :: Maybe a -> Maybe a
poem = fmap id

-- poem Nothing = Nothing

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN where the right table has no matching rows — the result fills with NULLs for every column you hoped to find
sketches.resonance: You can reach out to join with someone, but if they have no matching row for you, every answer comes back NULL.
sketches.draft:
SELECT self.name, other.reply
FROM   self
LEFT JOIN other
ON self.reaching_out = other.reaching_back;

sketches.mechanism: A weak reference that automatically becomes nil when the referenced object is deallocated — holding on without preventing departure
sketches.resonance: The only way to love without trapping is to hold weakly, accepting that they may become nil at any moment.
